messages.sendRefused: Send refused: the notifications mode is {mode}, so nothing was delivered. The draft stays in the outbox.
messages.sendDelivery: Sent with Microsoft Graph sendMail as the configured sender.

expired-documents.subject: Action required: expired document "{documentTitle}"
expired-documents.body:
Hello {ownerName},

The document "{documentTitle}" ({documentUrl}) is listed under "{findingTitle}" in the knowledge governance review. Its expiration date is {expirationDate} and its review date is {reviewDate}.

Please confirm whether the document should be renewed, superseded or archived, and reply to {reviewerName} with your decision.

Thank you.

requires-review.subject: Review needed: "{documentTitle}"
requires-review.body:
Hello {ownerName},

The document "{documentTitle}" ({documentUrl}) is flagged as "{findingTitle}" in the knowledge governance review. Its review date is {reviewDate}.

Please review the content and update its metadata in SharePoint. Reply to {reviewerName} when the review is complete.

Thank you.

draft-documents.subject: Draft still open: "{documentTitle}"
draft-documents.body:
Hello {ownerName},

The document "{documentTitle}" ({documentUrl}) is still a draft and is listed under "{findingTitle}". Please publish it, supersede it, or confirm it should stay out of the knowledge base.

Reply to {reviewerName} with the next step.

Thank you.

superseded-documents.subject: Superseded document to retire: "{documentTitle}"
superseded-documents.body:
Hello {ownerName},

The document "{documentTitle}" ({documentUrl}) is marked Superseded and is listed under "{findingTitle}". Please confirm it can be archived or removed from the library.

Reply to {reviewerName} with your decision.

Thank you.

exact-duplicates.subject: Duplicate content found: "{documentTitle}"
exact-duplicates.body:
Hello {ownerName},

The document "{documentTitle}" ({documentUrl}) has content identical to another document in the library and is listed under "{findingTitle}". Please confirm the canonical copy or remove this duplicate.

Reply to {reviewerName} with your decision.

Thank you.

near-duplicates.subject: Near-duplicate content found: "{documentTitle}"
near-duplicates.body:
Hello {ownerName},

The document "{documentTitle}" ({documentUrl}) is nearly identical to another document in the library and is listed under "{findingTitle}". Please confirm which copy is canonical.

Reply to {reviewerName} with your decision.

Thank you.

conflicting-authoritative.subject: Conflicting authoritative documents: "{documentTitle}"
conflicting-authoritative.body:
Hello {ownerName},

The authoritative document "{documentTitle}" ({documentUrl}) conflicts with another authoritative document and is listed under "{findingTitle}". Knowledge-owner review is required before either document is used.

Reply to {reviewerName} with the resolution.

Thank you.

conflicts-with-authoritative.subject: Conflict with an authoritative document: "{documentTitle}"
conflicts-with-authoritative.body:
Hello {ownerName},

The document "{documentTitle}" ({documentUrl}) conflicts with an authoritative document and is listed under "{findingTitle}". Please align its content or confirm the difference is intended.

Reply to {reviewerName} with your decision.

Thank you.
